_comment: Director perks: pick 1 of 3 every balance.perkEveryNHeists successful heists.

perks.flavour: Stay in character.
No green screens. Real explosions. Slightly fewer eyebrows.

perks.description: Everyone's fair cut is 5% higher, so a bigger Director's cut still feels fair.
perks.flavour: The Teamsters approve. Mostly.

perks.description: The first arrest of the run is prevented.
perks.flavour: Someone who looks just like them took the fall. Same moustache and everything.

perks.description: Once per night, preview a job's exact outcome before you commit.
perks.flavour: You've already seen how this one ends.
Blockbusters pay for the art films.

perks.description: +6% success when every crew member is a different type.
perks.flavour: Everybody plays the role they were born for.

perks.description: +3% success per crew member beyond the job's minimum.
perks.flavour: No small parts, only small getaway cars.
Catering is now a vending machine.

perks.description: Your cut never drops anyone's willingness below 0.6.
perks.flavour: They don't work for the money. They work for the vision.
Only seasoned professionals need apply.
Nobody touch anything. Unless it's valuable.
Found a lovely bank with great natural light.

perks.description: Crew can work 2 jobs per night, losing 3 loyalty for the second.
perks.flavour: Double shifts, triple coffee.
A rabbit's foot taped to the clapperboard.
Through the fruit stand. Always through the fruit stand.
Shot day-for-night. Nobody saw a thing.
Rewrote the alarm system's third act.
The tumblers fall in time with the score.

perks.description: Idle crew gain +1 loyalty per night.
perks.flavour: Free doughnuts buy a surprising amount of devotion.
Mattresses. Everywhere. Just out of shot.
